keyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 photorealistic photo of a ripe golden rice paddy in the Mekong Delta, Vietnam, at golden hour. Close-up of several heavy ripe golden rice panicles bending down in the center of the frame, the rice grains clearly visible. Blurred background: golden rice field, a row of coconut palms and a small wooden sampan boat on a canal. Warm sunlight from the left. Shallow depth of field. No people. Keep the panicles inside the middle 70 percent of the width. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. The rice has been harvested and milled. Show a top-down view of a large round white ceramic bowl filled with polished white rice grains, sitting in the center of a rustic dark wooden table. Two golden rice panicles lie on the table at the top edge. Same warm golden light from the left. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same bowl, the same top-down camera, the same table and the same light. The rice grains are gone: the bowl is now filled with soft, fine, pure white rice flour forming a smooth mound. A few white rice grains remain on the table next to the bowl. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same bowl, the same top-down camera, the same table and the same light. The flour has become a smooth, thin liquid batter of bright golden yellow color from turmeric, with a soft swirl of white coconut cream on top and a few chopped green onions floating. Next to the bowl on the table: a fresh turmeric root cut open and half a coconut. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the bowl of golden batter is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a hot black cast-iron pan. A thin round layer of golden turmeric batter has just been poured into the pan and is sizzling, its edges bubbling, a little steam rising. On one half of it lie a few pink shrimp, thin slices of pork belly and a handful of fresh bean sprouts. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same pan, the same top-down camera, the same table and the same light. The crepe is now fully cooked: thin, crispy, lacy golden-brown edges, and it is folded in half into a half-moon shape over the filling, with shrimp and bean sprouts peeking out. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The pan is gone. In the center, the same folded crispy golden banh xeo crepe now lies on a round white plate. Next to the plate: a small bamboo basket of fresh lettuce, mustard greens, perilla and mint leaves, and a small bowl of Vietnamese fish dipping sauce with chili and garlic slices. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Same dish, same table, same warm light, but now a close-up seen from a low 45-degree side angle. In the center, a hand holds a piece of the crispy golden banh xeo wrapped in a fresh lettuce leaf with herbs, just above the small bowl of fish dipping sauce. The plate and the basket of greens are softly blurred behind. Keep the hand and the roll inside the middle 70 percent of the width. No text, no watermark.

keyframes.prompt: Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same rustic dark wooden table and the same warm golden light. The camera has moved to the right: the pan is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a small round white dipping bowl filled with Vietnamese sweet and sour fish dipping sauce, light amber and clear, with minced garlic and thin red chili slices floating on top. Next to the bowl: half a squeezed lime, a small spoon, a few garlic cloves and red chilies. No text, no watermark.

clips.prompt: In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. The hand slowly dips the lettuce-wrapped crispy crepe roll into the fish sauce, lifts it up and breaks it in half, showing the crispy golden inside, a few crispy crumbs fall. Nothing else changes. Loud crunchy crispy sound, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. White rice grains slowly pour down from above into a large white bowl, while the camera smoothly tilts down to look straight down at the bowl filling up. Nothing else changes. Falling rice sounds, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Time-lapse. The white rice grains slowly crumble into fine white flour little by little, in a wave across the bowl. The bowl stays still. Nothing else changes. Soft grinding sound, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Golden turmeric water and white coconut milk slowly pour into the bowl and mix with the flour, which turns little by little into a smooth golden liquid batter. The bowl stays still. Nothing else changes. Pouring and stirring sounds, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. The camera smoothly slides to the right to a hot black cast-iron pan. A ladle pours golden batter into the pan, it sizzles and spreads thin, then shrimp, pork slices and bean sprouts are placed on one half. Nothing else changes. Loud sizzling sound, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Time-lapse. The crepe slowly turns crispy and golden brown, then a spatula folds it in half over the filling. The pan stays still. Nothing else changes. Sizzling and crackling sounds, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. [0-1.5s] The camera smoothly slides to the right to a small empty white dipping bowl on the table and stops. [1.5-8s] Static camera. Fish sauce is poured into the bowl, then a spoon of sugar, a squeeze of lime juice, minced garlic and sliced red chili are added, and a spoon stirs it slowly. Nothing else changes. Pouring and stirring sounds, no music, no dialogue.

In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. The camera slowly and smoothly pulls back and up, revealing the folded crispy golden crepe on a round white plate next to the bowl of fish sauce and a basket of fresh greens. Nothing else changes. Soft kitchen ambience, no music, no dialogue.
